about: Sources of the Answer Prompt Choice lesson. Facts come only from the protocol (Addendum C, with Addendum D for the rank rule), the Stage A progress log, the decisions file, the pilot-1 post-mortem, the selection record and the selector code, and the thesis ch3 (English draft re-translated from the Persian, thesis 895f600). Newest source wins. verified = read for the claims used here. Marks: [V] read in a file -> verified; our protocol choices and run results -> ours; [I] -> inferred.
